business_overview.one_sentence: UBA Investments Limited is an investment company with one single investment-holding segment, investing mainly in listed equity securities in Hong Kong.

segments.name: Investment holding
segments.business_substance: Dividend income and fair value/realised gains or losses from listed equity investments.

business_overview.revenue_model: Dividend income from listed equity investments plus gains/losses from FVTPL financial assets; no major customer disclosure because investment income dominates.
business_notes: The group held listed equity securities of HK$62.565m at 31 March 2025.
The group disposed of its only unlisted equity investment during the year.
Banking and telecommunications sectors contributed about 77% of dividend income from listed securities during the year.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Realised and unrealised gains/losses from listed and unlisted investment portfolio.
Loss from disposal of subsidiaries that held the unlisted equity investment.
non_recurring_items.source: Consolidated statement of profit or loss and note 27

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and bank balances, all denominated in HKD; includes short-term deposit at market interest rate.
funds_assets.source: Consolidated statement of financial position; note 18

funds_assets.business_substance: Client monies held by related licensed securities companies in normal course of business; unsecured, interest-free and no fixed repayment terms.

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - listed equity securities
investment_assets.business_substance: Listed equity securities held for trading/investment; Level 1 fair value based on active-market bid prices.

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - unlisted equity securities
investment_assets.business_substance: Only unlisted equity investment was disposed during the year.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Current accrued expenses; all financial liabilities are non-derivative and non-interest-bearing.
operating_liabilities.source: Consolidated statement of financial position; note 6 liquidity risk table

years.source: Consolidated cash flow statement comparative column

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Cash conversion cannot be interpreted like an ordinary operating company because FVTPL investment purchases/sales run through operating cash flow. 2025 positive OCF mainly reflects a HK$24.456m decrease in FVTPL assets.
